tasks.scope: Remove BaseService inheritance hierarchy from src/services/; migrate orders-service, customers-service, audit-service, billing-service, notifications-service to composition pattern.
tasks.what_worked: Migrating service-by-service with the orders-service first as the reference implementation. Each migration was reviewable in isolation; the test suite caught two real behaviour drifts at the audit-trail boundary.
tasks.blast_radius_outcome: Touched 14 files across src/services/. No production incidents in the four weeks following deployment. One follow-up bug (orders-service-T1-followup) caught at code review, not in production.
tasks.prd_anchor: No formal PRD — predates specflow adoption. Decision-log entry 2026-01-08 is the anchor.
tasks.what_didnt_work: Initial estimate (2 engineer-days) under-shot the billing-service migration by half a day because billing's BaseService overrides had silent dependencies on the parent class's retry behaviour. Decision-log entry was written after the fact rather than at the time of the call — added 2026-01-08 retroactively.

tasks.scope: Migrate top-level tests/ tree to sibling __tests__/ directories alongside source modules. Update vitest config and CI to discover tests under the new convention.
tasks.what_worked: One-shot scripted migration ran cleanly. The script was deleted after the migration — no need to keep a one-time tool around. Vitest's auto-discovery picked up the new layout without configuration changes.
tasks.blast_radius_outcome: Touched ~80 test files. CI ran green on first attempt. No bugs introduced.
tasks.what_didnt_work: One module (src/audit/) had its tests under both conventions during a long-running branch. The merge required manual reconciliation — five minutes, not a real cost, but worth noting.

tasks.scope: Install specflow plugin, run specflow:setup, populate admin/CONTEXT.md, profiles.json, pages.json, environment.json, rules/, decision-log.md from existing project context.
tasks.what_worked: feedback-loop-audit produced a strong starter draft of CONTEXT.md from the codebase scan — about 70% reusable as-is. The setup skill detected Playwright, Codex, and gh on the first run.
tasks.blast_radius_outcome: Created docs/specflow/ tree; no source changes. No incidents.
tasks.what_didnt_work: Profile drafting required two passes — the auto-generated personas were too generic. Real value came from rewriting them against the specific operator + warehouse + support archetypes the team actually serves. Lesson: profiles are the artefact most worth hand-tuning post-setup.

tasks.scope: Build the specflow:design skill — codebase-truth HTML/CSS mockup generator with Playwright iteration loop, Codex review hand-off, and mandatory comment block citing extracted source values.
tasks.what_worked: The Gate 2 debate manifest caught two speculative configurability findings (per-region threshold knobs without a concrete second consumer) before they hardened into the implementation. Goal-Driven Reviewer's binary verify-step requirement forced the convergence threshold to be explicit — 5% per-pixel diff measured by Playwright's matcher, configurable in admin/config.json — rather than left as 'looks fine'. Codex hand-off worked cleanly because environment.json detection had it flagged.
tasks.blast_radius_outcome: New skill in plugins/specflow/skills/design/. Two new commands (/specflow:design). No changes to existing skills; no migrations. Zero production touch.
tasks.what_didnt_work: Round 1 of the manifest produced 7 findings; some overlap between Devil's Advocate and Simplicity Reviewer (both flagged the same speculative config knob). Not a blocker — the closing entry deduplicated — but suggests the reviewer dispatch could be smarter about complementary lenses. Recorded as a Phase 3 pattern note.

tasks.scope: Add multi-row selection and a floating action bar to /orders. Bulk actions: assign, mark reviewed, change status. Keyboard navigation preserved — bulk-select with Shift+Click, Cmd+A select-all, Esc to clear.
tasks.what_worked: Power users adopted the bulk-select within a day; first-time-visitor support tickets started referencing the action bar within a week (positive signal — they discovered it without help). The Surgical Reviewer caught one adjacent-fix attempt (a refactor of the orders table's column-resize handler) and routed it to a misc-task instead of inlining it.
tasks.blast_radius_outcome: Touched 6 files in app/orders/ and packages/ui/src/components/action-bar/. New component documented in packages/ui/src/components/action-bar/README.md. No incidents; no follow-up bugs in the two weeks since ship.
tasks.what_didnt_work: Initial design draft tried to put bulk actions in a per-row menu; first-time-visitor profile review surfaced that this was less discoverable than the floating bar. Switched late in the design phase — added a half-day to the schedule.
